source_document.body:
Mars, Incorporated plans to invest about $1.4 billion in its U.S. manufacturing and operations next year, the company said on Tuesday. It would be the most it has ever invested in a single year.
What’s Related
The new spending builds on more than $9 billion Mars has put into its U.S. operations since 2017. The McLean, Virginia-based company makes more than 40 U.S. household brands, including M&M’S, CHEEZ-IT, Ben’s Original, PEDIGREE and Royal Canin.
“As Mars marks 115 years in business , our commitment to American manufacturing has never been stronger,” said Claus Aagaard, CFO of Mars, Incorporated.
Aagaard said the investments will help Mars expand manufacturing, grow its brands and services, and keep up with future consumer demand.
Mars did not provide a full breakdown of the $1.4 billion. Four new pet hospitals are the only 2027 projects the company named.
RELATED: Mars Among the Leaders in 2026 Best Places to Work List
Recent manufacturing investments
The 2027 plan follows several recent investments at Mars plants.
In Salt Lake City, Mars spent $60 million on two Trü Frü production lines inside a $240 million factory that opened last year for Nature’s Bakery. The site can make 17 million Trü Frü frozen products a year, plus more than 1 billion Nature’s Bakery snack bars.
In Waco, Texas , Mars is marking 50 years of operations this month. The company has invested $165 million there since 2024, mostly in energy efficiency and improving plant operations. Waco produces more than 56 billion pieces of SNICKERS, STARBURST and SKITTLES candy each year.
In Columbus, Ohio, Mars invested $49 million to bring TEMPTATIONS Lickable Treats production to the U.S., including new mixing and filling equipment. The investment will give the wet pet food plant capacity to make more than 400 million pouches a year. Mars has put $162 million into the Columbus plant since 2022.
Four new pet hospitals
As part of the 2027 commitment, Mars will spend more than $34 million to open four Mars Veterinary Health hospitals early next year.
Three will be BluePearl Pet Hospitals in Ellicott City, Maryland; Austin, Texas; and Katy, Texas. The fourth is a Banfield Pet Hospital in Wilmington, North Carolina. Together, the four sites are expected to create up to 195 jobs .
Made in the USA
Mars employs 80,000 people in the U.S. across more than 60 factories, research labs and offices, plus more than 2,000 veterinary clinics and hospitals. The company added 15 facilities in the past year through its acquisition of Kellanova.
“Ninety-four percent of the Mars products sold in the U.S. are made here,” Aagaard said.
